sourceLayout: Numerical pressure surface and pathlines from rebuilt Fluent cruise case

motion.source: Actual newly solved Fluent wall pressure and Fluent numerical pathline vertices.
motion.scope: New airframe-only visualization CFD on documented simplified shell. Lost original case/data are not reproduced. No rotor wake or new validated aerodynamic performance conclusion.
motion.pressureColorDisplay: Zero-centered blue-to-orange/red diverging colors with full-range asinh normalization. The wall and labeled nonlinear legend use the same unlit transfer; no pressure interpolation or clipping.
motion.markerRadiusPolicy: Marker centers remain on numerical paths; marker radius shrinks near the actual wall to avoid visual penetration.
motion.particleInterpolation: Piecewise linear between consecutive exported numerical path vertices, parameterized by actual exported/integrated physical travel time.
motion.pressureAnimation: Steady solved field held constant; only marker advection is animated.

studio.cameraBackgroundPolicy: Native antialiased object alpha over constant scene-linear neutral color after denoising.

encoding.resize: Lanczos downsample from shared native 1280x854 PNG
